notes.title: Big Updates after release: 202408
notes.notes: [p]After the game was released, we had lots of big upgrades:  [/p][olist][*][p]The main levels increased from 12 to 24 2. 10 hidden levels, [/p][/*][*][p]Alive levels, a total of 36 levels [/p][/*][*][p]Added a progress system, golden achievement rewards [/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 comfortable and relaxing background music [/p][/*][*][p]Added main interface animation, background animation, and light effect animation [/p][/*][*][p]Weakened the story voice [/p][/*][*][p]Improved time reversal and time loop [/p][/*][*][p]Added life+ scoring and life rankings [/p][/*][*][p]Added a level skip timer (Easy Mode)  [/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]Come on, try the diversity of puzzles, jump out of the complicated routines of traditional puzzle games, and make puzzles come alive. We hope that hours of leisure puzzling time will not bring you brain-burning fatigue, but your own sense of accomplishment.[/p]
